method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a private hospital supply's safety net value answers NOTHING, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: National Health Act 1953, Compilation No. 157, compilation date 19 September 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 90, 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C1953A00095.txt, Part VII; with reg 17A of the National Health (Pharmaceutical Benefits) Regulations 2017, Compilation No. 16, compilation date 15 August 2026 (register id F2026C00834), as deposited at ../../../national-health-pharmaceutical-benefits-regulations-2017/registers/source-bundle/F2017L00313.txt. The s 99G indexed amounts are inputs (the formulas were dropped from the text deposit); the cases use the printed figures, labelled.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in SOURCE-LICENSE.md (and, for the Regulations, in that subject's SOURCE-LICENSE.md)

checks.command: l4 run nha-patient.l4 ; l4 run nha-cases-patient.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Part VII from the patient's seat: entitlement (ss 85(2)-(3) as facts, 86(1)-(4), 86A(1), 89), concessional beneficiary and dependant (s 84(1), (4), (7)), the most the pharmacist may charge (s 87(1), (2), (2A), (3)), increased discounting (s 87AA), the safety nets (ss 84B, 84C(1AA)-(1D), 84CA, 99F) with reg 17A(3)-(4), the card's period (s 84J), refunds (s 87A). Indexed amounts (s 99G) are inputs. Out: card issue procedure, s 84C(4)-(4B) beyond the value stated, reg 17A(2), s 84BA, ss 85A-85E, 86B-86E, 87(4)-(6), 88-88A, 89A-98AC, Divisions 3-5, s 100, Parts I-VI and VIII onwards. Read with health-insurance-act-1973/encodings/baseline-2026-10 for 'eligible person' (not restated).
seat: the patient (and the family member whose medicines count with theirs)
